references.text: The same command to eat unleavened bread for seven days is given in connection with the institution of the Passover festival.
Describes the holy assembly on the seventh day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread.
Repeats the command to eat unleavened bread for seven days in the month of Abib.
Reminder of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, which is to be observed for seven days.
Detailed regulations concerning the seven-day Festival of Unleavened Bread, with a holy assembly on the seventh day.
Regulations regarding offerings during the seven-day Festival of Unleavened Bread.
Command to eat unleavened bread for seven days as a memorial of the exodus from Egypt.
Mentions the festival gathering on the seventh day of the feast.
Leviticus sets the exact start date (the 15th day) for the feast that Exodus 13:6 describes in terms of its duration.
Numbers confirms the duration of the feast from Exodus but places it within the context of the law of offerings.
Ezekiel confirms the seven-day festival structure from Exodus within a prophetic vision of the future temple.
Exodus 12:18 gives the exact time frame (evening to evening) for the seven-day period mentioned in Exodus 13:6.
